summary.text: K.J. Atwood is the Democratic candidate for the South Carolina House of Representatives, District 110, in the November 3, 2026 general election; the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary was canceled.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Mount Pleasant small-business owner who co-founded a marketing and design agency.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, K.J. Atwood said he is a Mount Pleasant small-business owner, husband and father, and a 12th-generation South Carolinian who grew up in a working-class family.

He said he earned degrees in biology and economics from Wofford College, a Master of International Business from the University of South Carolina, and a Master of Psychological Science from Rutgers University, where his research focused on political polarization.

He listed technology consulting at PwC, supporting South Carolina's public-health response during COVID-19, and co-founding the agency Half Dreaming with his wife, Caitlyn, as his professional background.
Atwood also ran for the U.S. House in South Carolina's 1st Congressional District but did not appear on the ballot for the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary, according to Ballotpedia.

For his state House campaign, he named affordability for Lowcountry families, ending corruption and special-interest influence through greater transparency, and addressing traffic, flooding and drainage while protecting marshes and waterways as his key messages.
